FRIERENMOD-SNUGGLE1.description: Discard up to {Amount} {Amount:plural:card|cards}. Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each [gold]Mana[/gold] discarded.

FRIERENMOD-AURA_DISPEL.title: Dispel Magic
FRIERENMOD-AURA_DISPEL.description: Destroy a Controlled Soldier, triggering [gold]Soul Release[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-ENDLESS_FLOW.title: Endless Flow
FRIERENMOD-ENDLESS_FLOW.description:
Add 1 [gold]Mana[/gold] to each of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], [gold]Hand[/gold], and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold]. Deal damage to ALL enemies equal to your total [gold]Mana[/gold].
(Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)

FRIERENMOD-KINDLING_SPARK.title: A Single Spark

(Add {ActualSparks} [gold]{ActualSparks:plural:Little Spark|Little Sparks}[/gold])|}
FRIERENMOD-CRYING.title: Waaah!
FRIERENMOD-CRYING.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Apply {Weak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold]. Swap this card's [gold]Block value[/gold] and [gold]Weak stacks[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-UNDERESTIMATED.title: You Underestimate Me
FRIERENMOD-UNDERESTIMATED.description: Gain [gold]Shrink[/gold] for 1 turn. Next turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw 1 additional card.
FRIERENMOD-ENCHANTED_STRIKE.title: Enchanted Strike
FRIERENMOD-ENCHANTED_STRIKE.description: Deal {CalculationBase} damage, plus {ExtraDamage:diff()} for each [gold]Mana[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. ({CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)
FRIERENMOD-TREASURE_VAULT_SPELL.title: Treasure Vault Protection Spell
FRIERENMOD-TREASURE_VAULT_SPELL.descript:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] X times. Generate {Upgraded:cond:X+1|X} [gold]Mana[/gold] in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].{InCombat:cond:
